title: Thai Curry Soup
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired soup made with juicy chicken, bitter greens, and a rich curry sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, diced tomato, and green curry leaves.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the bitter greens and cook until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green curry leaves if desired.
